item.title: Bitcoin Holds Near $78,900 as Asia Conference Opens and ETF Flows Trickle In
item.summary: BTC/USD closed at $78,901.997 at 02:00 UTC on August 27, up +0.108095 % over 24 hours on light Alpaca-reported volume, as Bitcoin Asia 2026 opened in Hong Kong and Fidelity's FBTC logged a $25.6 million daily ETF inflow.
